 "new_string": "    async def select_audience(\n        self,\n        material: str,\n        goal_hint: str = \"\",\n        cta_url: str = \"\",\n        data_capability: str = CAPABILITY_FULL,\n    ) -> AudienceSelection:\n        \"\"\"Run Agent 0 — infers marketing intent from the campaign brief and\n        returns an ``AudienceSelection`` containing ``query_params`` that will\n        feed into :func:`app.services.audience_service.query_users_from_db`.\n\n        ``data_capability`` is passed through from\n        ``probe_recipient_capability``. When ``\"minimal_email_lang\"``, the\n        prompt layer injects a hard directive forcing ``language_only``\n        and neutral reasoning, and the backend sanitisation layer\n        (``_build_audience_selection``) keeps a defence-in-depth guard:\n        if the LLM still returns a richer ``grouping_strategy``, it is\n        overwritten with ``language_only`` and the selection's\n        ``warnings`` list grows by one ``data_capability_minimal_override``\n        entry so the UI / trace makes the override visible.\n\n        Falls back to a safe default (全量 + 排除退订 + 排除近 30 天已发送) if\n        the LLM output cannot be parsed or validated.\n        \"\"\"\n        system = build_audience_selector_system_prompt(data_capability=data_capability)\n        user = build_audience_selector_user_prompt(material, goal_hint, cta_url)\n\n        try:\n            result = await self._strategy_agent().run(\n                system, user, temperature=0.5, max_tokens=1024,\n            )\n            raw = result.content\n            data = _extract_json(raw)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"Audience selector JSON parse failed: %s — using fallback\", exc)\n            return self._fallback_audience_selection(\n                \"AI 输出无法解析，使用兜底选人策略\",\n                data_capability=data_capability,\n            )\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"Audience selector run failed: %s — using fallback\", exc)\n            return self._fallback_audience_selection(\n                f\"AI 调用失败：{exc}\",\n                data_capability=data_capability,\n            )\n\n        selection = self._build_audience_selection(data, data_capability=data_capability)\n        # Soft advisories — never block the pipeline, but attach to the\n        # selection so the SSE layer can surface them to the UI.\n        audience_report = validate_audience(selection)\n        if audience_report.violations:\n            selection.warnings = [\n                *selection.warnings,\n                *[v.message for v in audience_report.violations],\n            ]\n        logger.info(\n            \"Audience selector completed in %d iterations: intent=%s, capability=%s, query_params=%s, warnings=%d\",\n            result.iterations,\n            selection.detected_intent,\n            selection.data_capability,\n            selection.query_params,\n            len(selection.warnings),\n        )\n        return selection\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _build_audience_selection(\n        data: dict, *, data_capability: str = CAPABILITY_FULL,\n    ) -> AudienceSelection:\n        \"\"\"Validate & normalise raw LLM output into an AudienceSelection.\n\n        Defence-in-depth: in the ``minimal_email_lang`` path, force\n        ``grouping_strategy`` to ``language_only`` and neutralise the\n        enrichment-flavoured ``query_params`` (segments / pay_status /\n        subscription_plan / active_within_days). We keep whatever the LLM\n        said for ``reasoning`` / ``grouping_reasoning`` — the audience\n        validator can still warn about inconsistent wording, but the\n        actual execution parameters are guaranteed minimal-safe.\n        \"\"\"\n        raw_params = data.get(\"query_params\") or {}\n        if not isinstance(raw_params, dict):\n            raw_params = {}\n        query_params = AIService._sanitize_query_params(raw_params)\n\n        raw_grouping = data.get(\"grouping_strategy\")\n        detected_intent_raw = str(data.get(\"detected_intent\") or \"feature_announcement\")\n\n        warnings: list[str] = []\n        if data_capability == CAPABILITY_MINIMAL:\n            effective_grouping = \"language_only\"\n            if isinstance(raw_grouping, str) and raw_grouping.strip() and raw_grouping.strip() != \"language_only\":\n                warnings.append(\n                    \"data_capability_minimal_override：Recipient 表只有 email+lang，\"\n                    f\"已将 grouping_strategy 从 {raw_grouping.strip()!r} 强转为 language_only\"\n                )\n            query_params[\"segments\"] = []\n            query_params[\"pay_status\"] = \"all\"\n            query_params[\"subscription_plan\"] = \"all\"\n            query_params[\"active_within_days\"] = 9999\n        else:\n            effective_grouping = AIService._sanitize_grouping_strategy(\n                raw_grouping,\n                detected_intent=detected_intent_raw,\n            )\n\n        return AudienceSelection(\n            detected_intent=detected_intent_raw,\n            reasoning=str(data.get(\"reasoning\") or \"\").strip(),\n            query_params=query_params,\n            expected_scale_hint=str(data.get(\"expected_scale_hint\") or \"\").strip(),\n            grouping_strategy=effective_grouping,\n            grouping_reasoning=str(data.get(\"grouping_reasoning\") or \"\").strip(),\n            warnings=warnings,\n            data_capability=data_capability,\n        )"
}

_skeleton_strategies_for_broadcast(\n        cls,\n        group_profiles: dict[str, UserGroupProfile],\n        material: str,\n        goal_hint: str = \"\",\n    ) -> dict[str, GroupStrategy]:\n        \"\"\"Rule-based skeleton strategies for the blind-send path.\n\n        Every ``lang_*`` group in the audience receives the *same* strategy\n        skeleton — language is not a behavioural dimension, just a delivery\n        channel. The fields are deliberately conservative:\n\n          * ``detected_intent=\"feature_announcement\"`` — the only intent\n            that stays honest when we lack payment / activity signals.\n          * ``tone=\"专业友好\"`` — neutral default, matches the Writer's\n            ``is_unknown_audience`` salutation branch.\n          * ``urgency_level=\"low\"`` — blind sends should never bluff\n            urgency; Gmail ``misleading_header`` hard-violations lie on\n            the other side of that fence.\n          * ``content_focus`` is intentionally empty so the Writer falls\n            back to素材原句 bullets rather than invented selling points;\n            if the Preflight agent populated better focus hints, the\n            caller can layer them on before calling the Writer.\n          * ``frequency_hint`` / ``personalization_hints`` remain empty —\n            blind sends have no signal to personalise on.\n          * ``acceptance_criteria`` is the minimal Sprint Contract the\n            Content Evaluator will score against: fidelity to the\n            material, no placeholder leakage, no spoofed identity.\n\n        Marketing-material / goal_hint currently don't alter the skeleton\n        — we keep them in the signature so a future pass can derive a\n        tighter intent (``promotion`` vs ``feature_announcement``) from\n        keyword heuristics without breaking the call site.\n        \"\"\"\n        _ = material, goal_hint  # reserved for future heuristic upgrades\n\n        strategies: dict[str, GroupStrategy] = {}\n        for gid, p in group_profiles.items():\n            strategies[gid] = GroupStrategy(\n                group_id=gid,\n                group_label=p.group_label or gid,\n                detected_intent=\"feature_announcement\",\n                tone=\"专业友好\",\n                content_focus=[],\n                cta_direction=\"引导用户点击主 CTA，文案以素材里已声明的行动为准\",\n                urgency_level=\"low\",\n                avoid_list=list(cls._BROADCAST_AVOID_LIST),\n                personalization_hints=[],\n                strategy_reasoning=(\n                    \"盲发降级模式：Recipient 只有 email+lang，无法做差异化策略。\"\n                    \"全部 lang_* 组共用同一套中性广播 skeleton，由 Content Writer 的\"\n                    \" is_unknown_audience 分支保障称呼中性。\"\n                ),\n                frequency_hint=\"\",\n                acceptance_criteria=list(cls._BROADCAST_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA),\n            )\n        return strategies"

 I'm noticing that the recipients.py and recipient_service.py files lack logging, which is why we can't see the actual error details in the backend logs. Actually, let me think through the encoding issue more carefully. The user's CSV might be in GBK or GB2312 encoding (common from Chinese Excel exports), but pd.read_csv defaults to UTF-8, which would cause a UnicodeDecodeError. There's also the possibility of a BOM header (the byte sequence EF BB BF) that pd.read_csv doesn't handle cleanly — it gets prepended to the first column name, turning "email" into "\ufeffemail". The strip() method won't remove this BOM character since it only strips whitespace, not zero-width non-breaking spaces.

I can verify this is the issue: the frontend validation checks if the header includes 'email', and in JavaScript that substring match would still pass even with the BOM prefix, but the backend would fail when looking for the exact column name. So I need to fix the CSV parsing by using utf-8-sig encoding to automatically strip the BOM, add fallback support for GBK/GB18030 encodings, and add logging so the backend can report the specific error reason. I'll modify the parse_and_import_csv function in the recipient service to handle these cases. 现在开始实施修复方案。

## 问题诊断

你的 CSV 上传连续 3 次返回 400，但后端日志**完全没打印原因**（只有 `400 Bad Request` 这一行 access log，没有业务 detail）。这是第一个要修的基础设施缺口。

根据代码走读，前端已经在浏览器里做了最基本的校验（文件扩展名、至少一行、包含 email/lang 字眼），还能到后端挂掉，最可能的根因是：

**CSV 编码问题** — Excel / WPS 导出 CSV 时常见两种情况：
1. **UTF-8 带 BOM** (`\ufeff`)：前端 `'email,lang'.includes('email')` 仍返回 `true`（能通过前端校验），但后端 pandas 解析后第一列名变成 `\ufeffemail`，然后 `.strip().lower()` 不会去掉 BOM（BOM 不是空白字符），结果触发 "Missing required columns: email"。
2. **GBK / GB18030 编码**（中文 Windows 默认）：`pd.read_csv` 默认按 UTF-8 解码，遇到 GBK 中文字符会抛 `UnicodeDecodeError`，被吞进 "Cannot parse CSV" 的 500 行业务异常。

## 修改内容

**`edm-backend/app/services/recipient_service.py`**
- 新增 `_read_csv_with_fallback()`：依次用 `utf-8-sig` → `gb18030` → `gbk` → `utf-8` 尝试解析，第一个能读通就用（`utf-8-sig` 会自动剥掉 BOM）。
- 列名清洗增加 `lstrip('\ufeff')`：防止某些极端情况下 BOM 绕过编码层跑到列名里。
- "Missing required columns" 错误会额外带上 **实际检测到的列名** + **使用的编码**，方便下次秒定位。

**`edm-backend/app/api/recipients.py`**
- 给 `upload_csv` 补上完整日志链：收到文件（带 size）→ 可预期错误（warning + detail）→ 未预期崩溃（exception + stack）→ 成功（info + 统计）。

## 建议你现在做的

请在前端 **再传一次相同的 CSV**（后端已 reload，无需重启）：

- 如果这次成功，说明就是编码问题被兜底解决了。
- 如果还失败，打开**后端终端**（运行 uvicorn 的那个），会看到一行 `upload_csv parse_and_import_csv ValueError: filename='xxx.csv', detail=...`，detail 就是真正的根因。把那行贴给我，我继续修。

最常见的剩余可能性：CSV 列分隔符是 `;` 而不是 `,`（欧洲 Excel 默认），或者是 `.xlsx` 被直接改了扩展名为 `.csv`（其实是二进制）。这两个靠当前日志能立刻认出来。

 The application has restarted successfully and the fixes are now active. I should let the user know that I've identified the root cause—likely BOM or GBK encoding from Excel or Chinese software exports—and implemented fallback handling in the CSV reading logic to address this.

 "old_string": "def _detect_enrichment_columns(columns: set[str]) -> dict[str, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Map each enrichment dimension to the actual column name found (or None).\"\"\"\n    resolved: dict[str, str | None] = {}\n    for canonical, aliases in ENRICHMENT_CSV_COLUMNS.items():\n        resolved[canonical] = next((a for a in aliases if a in columns), None)\n    return resolved",
 "new_string": "def _detect_enrichment_columns(columns: set[str]) -> dict[str, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Map each enrichment dimension to the actual column name found (or None).\"\"\"\n    resolved: dict[str, str | None] = {}\n    for canonical, aliases in ENRICHMENT_CSV_COLUMNS.items():\n        resolved[canonical] = next((a for a in aliases if a in columns), None)\n    return resolved\n\n\ndef _canonicalize_required_columns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    \"\"\"Rename required-column aliases (e.g. ``language`` → ``lang``) in-place.\n\n    Only touches columns listed in ``REQUIRED_CSV_COLUMN_ALIASES``; never\n    overwrites an existing canonical column, so ``email,language,lang`` keeps\n    the original ``lang`` and drops nothing — downstream ``row.get('lang')``\n    remains deterministic.\n    \"\"\"\n    existing = set(df.columns)\n    rename_map: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for canonical, aliases in REQUIRED_CSV_COLUMN_ALIASES.items():\n        if canonical in existing:\n            continue\n        for alias in aliases:\n            if alias == canonical:\n                continue\n            if alias in existing:\n                rename_map[alias] = canonical\n                break\n    if rename_map:\n        df = df.rename(columns=rename_map)\n    return df"
}

```51:80:edm-backend/app/services/recipient_service.py

        "language_code",
        "locale_code",
        "语言",

        "语言代码",
    ),
}
```

**新增 `_canonicalize_required_columns(df)`** 在列名清洗（BOM / 大小写）之后、缺列校验之前执行一次。它只做一件事：把**存在别名但缺 canonical 名**的列 rename 过来（例如 `language` → `lang`），且**绝不覆盖**已存在的 canonical 列——这保证下游所有 `row.get("email")` / `row.get("lang")` 的契约都不用动。

**强化错误信息**：如果别名也没救回来，`Missing required columns` 错误里会额外列出所有可接受的别名，用户能立刻对着 CSV 改 header。

## 你现在做的

直接**再传一次同一个 CSV**（`email_jp_details_20260420.csv`）就可以了，不用改文件。`language` 会被自动认作 `lang`。

如果你方便的话，也可以把 CSV 的 header 改成 `lang` 以对齐内部约定 —— 两种方式都能走通，看你偏好。

---

顺带说一下：刚才这条链路里有三个独立但叠加的"坑"，我们分别修好了：

1. **编码** — `utf-8-sig` / `gb18030` / `gbk` / `utf-8` 兜底
2. **BOM** — 列名清洗时 `lstrip('\ufeff')`，`.strip()` 对 BOM 无效
3. **列名别名** — `language` → `lang`、`mail` → `email` 等同义词自动 canonicalize

所以无论 CSV 来源是 Excel 中英文环境 / WPS / 业务系统导出，现在都能兼容。
